items.title: 8.6 Podon mein ghiza ki naqal (translocation) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.6, printed pages 187-189.

blocks.text: Phloem woh vascular tissue hai jo organic nutrients, khaas kar photosynthesis ki paidawar, patton se pode ke un doosre hisson tak le jata hai jahan un ki zaroorat hai ya jahan woh zakheera hote hain. Secondary growth wale podon mein yeh aam taur par primary aur secondary vascular tissue dono ke bahar ki taraf hota hai, aur andarooni chhaal (inner bark) banata hai. Phloem sieve elements, companion cells, phloem fibres aur phloem parenchyma par mushtamil hai.

Sugars aur doosra organic mawad le jane wale cells sieve tube elements hain. In mein sieve areas hote hain, cell wall ke woh hisse jahan surakh parosi elements ko jorte hain; kuch sieve areas siron ki deewaron mein bante hain jahan cells sira-ba-sira jur kar ek tooli silsila, sieve tube, banate hain. Har sieve tube element ke saath ek ya zyada companion cells hote hain, jo plasmodesmata ke zariye us se rabta rakhte aur use ATP aur proteins dete hain. Phloem parenchyma sugars, resins, latex aur mucilage jaise maddey rakhta hai jo pode ke difa aur nami rakhne ke liye aham hain.

Sugars phloem se le jai jati hain. Phloem mein sugar ki harkat ki raftar ke liye diffusion bohat hi sust hai: yeh raftar ausatan 1 metre fi ghanta hai, jab ke diffusion se 1 metre tay karne mein aath saal lagte.

Pressure-flow theory, jise mass-flow hypothesis bhi kehte hain, phloem mein sugar ki naqal ki sab se zyada maani hui wazahat hai. Translocation sugar ko source se, jahan woh banti hai, sink tak le jati hai, jahan woh istemal ya zakheera hoti hai. 1930 mein Ernst Munch ki tajweez kardah yeh theory source aur sink ke darmiyan osmotic pressure ke farq par qaim hai.

items: Mesophyll cells mein photosynthesis se bani glucose respiration mein istemal hoti hai; zaid ko ghair-takhfeefi (non-reducing) sugar sucrose mein badla jata hai.

Sucrose mesophyll cells se phloem ke companion cells mein active transport se le jai jati hai, aur wahan se plasmodesmata ke zariye sieve tubes mein diffuse hoti hai, to sieve tubes mein sucrose ki concentration barhti hai.
Sieve tubes mein sucrose (solute) ki zyada concentration ki wajah se patte ke qareebi xylem se pani osmosis se un mein aata hai, jo sieve tubes ke source sire par water potential barha deta hai.

Sink sire par sugar sieve tubes se faal taur par utari (unload) jati hai aur pani osmosis se peeche jata hai; pani ka nikalna sink sire par water potential gira deta hai. To source sire par zyada aur sink sire par kam water potential hota hai.
Water potential ka farq pani ko source se sink ki taraf bahata hai, aur chunke sucrose pani mein hal hai, woh source se sink tak saath beh jati hai.

blocks.alt: Ek xylem nali aur ek phloem sieve tube pehlu-ba-pehlu. Oopar ek patta (source) phloem mein sucrose load karta hai aur xylem se pani aata hai; ek mota jamni teer sieve tube mein neeche behta ras (sap) dikhata hai; neeche sucrose ek sink mein utarti hai aur pani xylem ko wapas jata hai. Daen box zyada dabao wale source sire aur kam dabao wale sink sire ka muqabla karte hain.
blocks.caption: Translocation ki pressure-flow theory (Figure 8.11 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Source par zaid glucose se bani sucrose companion cells aur sieve tubes mein faal taur par load hoti hai, xylem se pani osmosis se peeche aata hai, aur dabao barhta hai. Sink par sucrose faal taur par utarti hai, pani us ke peeche bahar jata hai aur dabao girta hai. Dabao ka farq sieve tube mein source se sink tak ras ka mass flow chalata hai, jo hal shuda sucrose saath le jata hai; akela diffusion bohat hi sust hota.

blocks.prompt: Pressure-flow theory ko dono siron par active transport kyun chahiye jab ke beech ka bahao passive hai?
blocks.explanation: Source par faal loading sieve tube mein sucrose ki concentration barhati hai taake pani aaye aur dabao bane; sink par faal unloading sucrose hata deti hai taake pani nikle aur dabao gire. Sirf in do faal qadmon se bana dabao ka farq ras ke passive mass flow ko source se sink tak itni tezi se, qareeb 1 metre fi ghanta, chala sakta hai.

items: Phloem (andarooni chhaal) photosynthesis ki paidawar le jata hai: sieve areas se jur kar sieve tubes banane wale sieve tube elements, plasmodesmata se ATP aur proteins dene wale companion cells, phloem fibres aur sugars, resins, latex aur mucilage rakhne wala parenchyma.

Diffusion bohat hi sust hai (1 metre fi ghanta ke muqable aath saal mein 1 metre). Munch ki pressure-flow theory (1930): source par faal load hui sucrose pani kheenchti aur dabao barhati hai; sink par faal unloading pani chhorti aur dabao girati hai; ras source se sink tak sucrose le kar behta hai.
